authorization: User asks autonomous D15 exploration and clear comprehensive variable matrix, charts preferred.

rounds.question: How do 20 prespecified initialization structures change optimization and validation response across 3 tasks and 3 activations?
rounds.hypothesis: Front-loaded initialization is universally preferable to back-loaded within this registered grid.
rounds.criterion: Support universal superiority only if median paired final validation loss front/back <=0.95 AND at least 3/4 paired seeds improve in every task x activation x optimizer x learning-rate context; otherwise refuted/mixed; failures retained.

rounds.question: Does the response to six fixed initialization structures persist when architecture, depth, width and input spectrum vary?
rounds.criterion: Report paired improvement direction, win fractions, baseline-normalized final MSE and threshold success; no general superiority claim from pooled cells.

rounds.question: How do depth trend, alternation and global scale jointly affect responses under fixed architecture?
rounds.criterion: Display full surfaces including failure counts; grid minima are development descriptions, not validated recommendations.

tasks.linear: fixed per-draw random unit linear direction
tasks.relu_teacher: fixed per-draw 16-unit random ReLU teacher without bias
tasks.inputs: paired Gaussian inputs shared across target tasks; covariance diagonal geomspace(1,1/condition,8)
tasks.normalization: targets divided by training RMS only; same scaling on validation; no centering
tasks.validation_role: development diagnostics; not a final benchmark test or independent method-selection confirmation

initialization.base: independent N(0,1/fan_in) per weight element, common base seed per depth/width/draw
initialization.positive_profiles: center logarithmic layer scales; product of positive multipliers=1 except overall scale s0
initialization.zas_embed: rectangular identity first projection and square internal identity, final zero; not identical to original square-output theorem
initialization.identity_random: (I+G)/sqrt2 re-normalized to baseline per-layer Frobenius norm
initialization.baseline: uniform under exact same context and seed

metrics.primary: paired final validation MSE ratio against baseline, median across seeds; all failure counts explicit
secondary: first integer-step train MSE<=0.1 and <=0.01; -1 never hit
initial layer gradients and all-zero flag
metrics.nonfinite: not dropped; failed paths cannot be counted as wins; conservative paired ratio=+infinity when candidate fails and baseline finite; ratios unavailable if baseline fails
metrics.floors: known linear least-squares floor only for plain+linear; no floor claim for nonlinear models
metrics.uncertainty: seed-level values available; do not interpret small seed counts as precise population confidence

safety.history: existing 5184-path layer-scale transfer not rerun; all old evidence untouched
safety.restarts: only hash-verified completed batches skipped, never overwritten
safety.dirty_index: independent worktree shares repository but preserves user's index

audit.before: independent scalar PyTorch tests; source hashes compared to preregistration Git commit before training
audit.after: all saved batch hashes and denominators, source commit chronology; independent final-forward and initial-grad recomputation; recompute all public summaries from saved arrays
audit.scope: synthetic development grid; seed is replication, not new task
